title: CoverMem: Coverage-Constrained Visual Memory for Budgeted Embodied Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2611.32119v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Episodic-memory embodied question answering enables agents to answer questions based on previously recorded visual observations of the surrounding scenes. However, growing observation histories, varying observation quality across viewpoints, and limited computational resources make it challenging to construct and maintain compact visual memories while retrieving sufficient evidence for question answering. translated_title: CoverMem：面向预算受限具身问答的覆盖约束视觉记忆
translated_abstract: 情景记忆具身问答使智能体能够基于先前记录的周围场景视觉观察来回答问题。然而，不断增长的观察历史、不同视角下观察质量的差异以及有限的计算资源，使得在检索足够证据用于问答的同时构建和维护紧凑的视觉记忆变得极具挑战。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了CoverMem，它包含三个关键组件：（1）一种覆盖约束的记忆构建方法，从完整帧中选择一个紧凑且信息丰富的集合，以满足对象质量和代表性场景的覆盖要求；（2）一种保持覆盖性的增量维护策略，当新观察到达时，仅对受影响的帧进行局部重选以满足更新的覆盖要求；（3）一种预算受限的互补帧选择方法，在问题相关性、增量覆盖价值与计算预算之间取得平衡。
tldr: CoverMem通过覆盖约束的记忆构建、保持覆盖性的增量维护和预算受限的互补帧选择，在有限计算资源下为具身问答构建紧凑且证据充分的视觉记忆。
en_tdlr: CoverMem enables compact and evidence-sufficient visual memory for embodied question answering under limited computational budget through coverage-constrained memory construction, coverage-preserving incremental maintenance, and budgeted complementary frame selection.
